FISHING LICENCE · ANDORRA

Andorra fishing licence

Visitors need an Andorran fishing licence. A managed fishing area also requires its own acotat permit, including areas where you must release the catch.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Visitors who fish in rivers or lakes.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Tourist day licencenon resident1 dayEUR 40
Tourist three-day licencenon resident3 daysEUR 70
Tourist catch-and-release day licencenon resident1 dayEUR 20
Tourist catch-and-release three-day licencenon resident3 daysEUR 30

Extra stamps and permits

  • Acotat catch-and-release permit · EUR 2
    Required in a designated catch-and-release area, in addition to the licence.
  • Intensive acotat permit · EUR 9
    Required in an intensive fishing area; the listed permit allows four catches.

Rules visitors should know

  • Carry the acotat permit when you fish in a managed area.
  • Use a single barbless artificial hook in catch-and-release areas.
  • Use a landing net and return fish alive immediately in catch-and-release areas.
  • Check the official map for the season of each water.

How to buy

Use Pesca en línia, a fishing shop, or a local tourism office.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Andorra?

Visitors need an Andorran fishing licence. A managed fishing area also requires its own acotat permit, including areas where you must release the catch.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Andorra?

Tourist day licence: EUR 40; Tourist three-day licence: EUR 70; Tourist catch-and-release day licence: EUR 20; Tourist catch-and-release three-day licence: EUR 30 (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Andorra?

Use Pesca en línia, a fishing shop, or a local tourism office.
